scope.scope_warning: These results concern only tenant 1 / Project 4. They must not be promoted to the later new tenant / Project chain or to full A0-A31 release proof.

method: Read prompt sections 8-16 and historical scenario-coverage-register A0-A7 definitions; historical results were not edited.
Corroborated the actually executed fresh setup manifest with PostgreSQL SELECT in BEGIN READ ONLY / ROLLBACK.
Read existing records through five authenticated GET endpoints using the application's token issuer and actual tenant-scoped actor 4; no mock API and no business command were used.
A PASS here means the specifically stated backend case assertions were observed. It never means browser execution, full A0-A31 completion, release readiness, or authorized business acceptance.
Composite cases remain BLOCKED where their wider register assertions, required UI traversal, or current read-model behavior were not validated. Source presence alone is not execution evidence.

Independent pre-publication/post-publication no-live-business side-effect assertions; the setup's declared initial Project count alone is not that complete proof.

cases.business_process: Strategic capital demand, cycles, buckets and allocation
cases.actual: Cycle 1 OPEN covers 2027-01-01 to 2030-12-31. Demand 1 was endorsed by actor 8 after author 4 / reviewer 5. Allocation 1 ENDORSED records grow/sustain targets 80/20 and a retained endorsed snapshot hash. Authenticated comparison GET reports USD 100,000,000 current demand in grow, classification coverage 100%, no FX conversion, and empty Recommended/Approved positions. Thus this observed planning endorsement did not become Budget/FID authorization.
limitations: Backend case only; the corresponding screen was not opened in the blocked browser journey.

cases.business_process: Idea, evaluation and governed Business Analysis
cases.actual: Idea 1 was originated from Demand 1, submitted, independently screened/routed, evaluated and accepted. The completed setup executed the mandatory READY_FOR_BUSINESS_ANALYSIS assertion before BA. BA 1 was authored by actor 4 and completed by independent reviewer 5 using the real lifecycle and evaluated alternatives. Its completion hash is retained by Proposal 1. Current authenticated Idea readiness GET is READY_FOR_PROJECT_PROPOSAL with no blockers.
limitations: The intermediate READY_FOR_BUSINESS_ANALYSIS assertion passed in the completed execution but its full response was not independently serialized as a separate snapshot.
No browser BA/Idea screen was reached.

cases.actual: Proposal 1 was created from the same eligible Idea/BA, populated with scope, need, justification, benefits, USD 100,000,000 ROM, 2027-2030 dates, risks, assumptions, constraints, sponsor and owner; it reached stored READY_FOR_STRATEGIC_GATE. Gate 1's persisted input proves handoff READY_FOR_STRATEGIC_GATE_DECISION at entry. After APPROVE, Proposal 1 is STRATEGIC_GATE_APPROVED, but its current gate-readiness GET reports GATE07B_REWORK_REQUIRED / PROPOSAL_NOT_EVALUATED. This inconsistent current read-model prevents claiming the wider current case as unqualified PASS.

Gate 1 was prepared by actor 4, submitted, independently reviewed, and formally APPROVE-decided by authorized actor 7. Authenticated intake-readiness GET remains READY_FOR_PORTFOLIO_INTAKE with no blockers. The tenant still has no investment decision and Project 4 remains pending: this strategic approval was not FID or activation.
limitations: Happy-path APPROVE only; RETURN/REJECT/DEFER negative cases are not promoted from source coverage.
No Strategic Gate screen was visited in Chromium.

cases.business_process: Governed Project creation / materialization and timing
cases.actual: Governed Request 1 CAPITAL_OWNER was submitted by actor 4, reviewed by actor 5, independently approved by actor 9 and materialized by actor 10. Exactly one canonical tenant Project currently exists: 4, pending, with generated Record Code and stable non-null external_key. Intake effective_from follows materialization. The wider case's initialization/activation eligibility and duplicate/replay materialization boundaries were not all executed on this same chain.
missing: Actual initialization/activation eligibility and pre-FID refusal evidence for this same Project.
Explicit duplicate/replay materialization assertion; a current count of one is not a concurrency/idempotency proof.

cases.actual: Current API and SQL confirm Membership 1 ACTIVE / STRATEGIC_INTAKE joins Portfolio 3 to the same pending CAPITAL_OWNER Project 4, with original Proposal 1 and Strategic Gate 1 lineage. Planning GET is READY_FOR_PORTFOLIO_PLANNING; portfolio evaluation and Project definition entry are allowed. The source register also requires independent membership in another Portfolio without changing canonical parent; that wider assertion was not executed.
